note: P4268 (Pro 25:19) — trusting a treacherous man in trouble is like a bad tooth or a slipping foot.

dims.v: misplaced reliance — leaning on a treacherous man in the crisis
the trust/reliance placed in a treacherous man in the time of trouble — confidence that fails just when it is needed, like a bad tooth or a foot that slips
the treacherous man it leans on (266022)
welded to the faithless man it wrongly relies on

mibtach (trust/confidence) — 'TRUSTING in a treacherous man in time of trouble'; to rely on the unreliable is agony in the crisis — the support gives way underfoot. Misplaced trust wounds like a rotten tooth.
unreliability — the faithless one who fails in the crisis
the treacherous, faithless man on whom one leans in trouble, only to be failed — reliability absent just when it matters
the trust that leans on him (266021)
welded to the misplaced reliance he betrays
bagad (deal treacherously) — 'a TREACHEROUS man in time of trouble'; the faithless man collapses under weight, failing precisely in the crisis. His unreliability is a snare to those who lean on him.
